# Book drop collection

The exterior book drop is emptied twice on an open day: once before opening and
once at close. Everything found in the morning emptying is checked in with the
previous open day's date, which is what protects a borrower who returned an item
after hours from an overdue fine.

The drop is locked shut when it is full rather than left to overflow, and a sign
directs borrowers to the desk. A full drop is treated as a same-hour job because
stock left on the step is stock that gets rained on.

Audiovisual cases and items on interlibrary loan must not be put in the drop.
Both are separated during check-in and, in the interlibrary loan case, checked
in by hand against the supplier's paperwork.

Glass, food, and anything wet found in the drop is bagged and logged; the log is
reviewed monthly because a repeated pattern usually means the drop needs
resiting rather than a warning notice.
